'''Diamal''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Diamal system/Legends|Diamal system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was the homeworld of the [[Diamal]]. The planet was frequently in conflict with its neighbor, [[Isht]].<ref name="Spec" />
